hourly.title: Charge by hour
hourly.intro: Enable the squads you need. Pay for access one hour at a time.
hourly.allowanceHint: Hourly squads share one allowance and reduced speed across all nodes. The free allowance renews at 00:00 UTC.
hourly.extraExpiry: Extra credit is shared by your hourly squads and expires at 00:00 UTC. If unfunded, traffic uses the reduced speed.
hourly.extraUnavailable: Extra traffic purchases are unavailable. Your existing credit remains usable until its expiry.
hourly.extraWarning: After the free allowance is exhausted, automatically debit {price} TXB for each 1 GB block (1,000,000,000 bytes). Credit is shared by hourly squads and expires at 00:00 UTC, including credit left after disabling squads. If another block cannot be funded, reduced speed applies.
hourly.acceptedPrice: Your approved price ceiling: {price} TXB per GB.
hourly.reviewPrice: Review the higher price to resume extra purchases
hourly.accountingPending: Some traffic is still being reconciled. Reserved credit remains unavailable until confirmed.
hourly.legacyBlocked: You have an active fixed-term purchase or a paid queued successor. Keep using or renewing those benefits; hourly activation becomes available after they end.
hourly.legacyShort: A fixed-term purchase blocks hourly activation.
hourly.salesPaused: New hourly activations are paused. Existing paid access and renewals keep their hourly terms.
hourly.billingTerms: Activation requires a balance covering {hours} hours of this squad. This is an eligibility check, not a debit or reservation. The remaining part of the current UTC hour is charged immediately, rounded up to the smallest currency unit. Following hours are prepaid at each whole UTC hour. Insufficient funds suspend that squad.
hourly.empty: No hourly squads are available yet.
hourly.disableWarning: Access stops immediately. The already-paid hour is not refunded. You must wait {hours} hours before enabling this squad again. Unused extra traffic credit is retained only until 00:00 UTC.
hourly.notReady: This squad is not ready for hourly activation.
hourly.loadFailed: Hourly access could not be loaded.
hourly.actionFailed: This change could not be confirmed. Refresh the status before trying again.
hourly.conflict: The policy, price or account state changed. Refresh, review the current terms and try again.
hourly.applicationPending: Your request is being applied. Access follows the confirmed status and paid boundary.
hourly.applicationFailed: This change failed. Review the current account and paid status before trying again.
hourly.applicationUnconfirmed: This change needs review. Check the current account and paid status; application is not confirmed.

result.HOURLY_LEGACY_ACTIVE: A fixed-term purchase blocks hourly activation. Existing renewals remain available.
result.HOURLY_CAPACITY: The hourly service has reached its account capacity. No activation charge was made.
result.HOURLY_COOLDOWN: This squad is still in its disable cooldown.
result.HOURLY_TERMS_CHANGED: The reviewed policy, price or account state changed. Refresh before trying again.
result.ACCOUNT_GENERATION_SUPERSEDED: This request belongs to an earlier account state and has ended. Refresh the account before continuing.
result.HOURLY_ACTIVATION_CANCELLED: The unpaid activation was cancelled. No hourly access was enabled.

reasons.insufficient_balance: Your balance does not meet the activation requirement.
reasons.cooldown: This squad is in its disable cooldown.
reasons.legacy_blocked: A fixed-term purchase blocks hourly activation.
reasons.capacity: This squad has no available places.
reasons.global_capacity: The hourly service has reached its account capacity. Try again later.
reasons.agent_incompatible: Participating nodes are not ready for hourly access.

admin.title: Charge by hour
admin.intro: Configure account-wide UTC traffic terms and separate hourly squad offers. Existing fixed-term purchases are preserved.
admin.salesHint: Pausing sales does not cancel paid hours or stop existing hourly renewals.
admin.allowanceHint: Shared across hourly squads. Accepts 1GB, 500MiB, or exact bytes; 1 GB = 1,073,741,824 bytes. Renews at 00:00 UTC. An existing day's allowance is retained; new days use this value. Zero is allowed.
admin.rateHint: Account-wide after allowance. Accepts 100Mbps, 12.5MB/s, or exact bytes/second. Required for sales; maximum 1,000,000,000,000 bytes/s.
admin.extraPrice: Extra traffic · TXB per decimal GB
admin.extraHint: One block is 1,000,000,000 bytes. Zero disables new extra purchases. Credit expires at 00:00 UTC.
admin.activationHint: Eligibility only: hourly price × hours. No debit or reservation of this amount.
admin.cooldownHint: Default 86,400 seconds (24 hours). Funding suspension does not start a cooldown.
admin.offersHint: Prices are independent of fixed-term products. Disabling an offer blocks new activations; existing enrollments renew at the current hourly price. Configure a positive price before enabling an offer.
admin.noSquads: Create an X-Node squad before configuring an hourly offer.
admin.invalidInteger: Enter a whole number within the supported range.
admin.invalidSize: Enter a valid size such as 1GB, 500MiB, or exact bytes.
admin.invalidRate: Enter a valid speed such as 100Mbps, 12.5MB/s, or exact bytes/second.
admin.invalidPrice: Enter a non-negative TXB amount with at most two decimals within the supported balance range.
admin.positiveRate: Set a positive reduced speed before enabling sales.
admin.positivePrice: An enabled offer requires a positive hourly price.
